desc: The 1014 Tradesman shotgun come from the factory with a preinstalled picatinny style rail with a ghost ring rear sight that is windage/elevation adjustable, adjustable front post with contrasting white dot that is also adjustable for windage and a Agency Arms M-LOK Handguard. The 18.5" barrel features the Benelli/Mobil pattern choke tube system for consistent patterns that can be tuned to any shot type load.
